title: 第十四章 后天六重
slug: 武神空间全本免费-武神空间最新章节列表
content_zh:
这头铁背银猿王果然是猛的一塌糊涂！
双方已经打急眼了，也顾不得之前为什么打上了，铁背银猿蛮力无敌，但是张家的武者们也都是各自习有各种武学，一时间也是难舍难分。
那个刀疤脸中年男子已经对上了铁背银猿王了，不过刚才还杀意滔天的刀疤脸中年男子被铁背银猿王完全压入了下风，他不过是后天七重，但是这头铁背银猿王已经是后天八重了，稳稳的压着他一头。
叶希文知道，这些武者的败退只是时间的问题了，叶希文悄悄离开了战场，绕了过去，奔向铁背银猿群的老巢。
现在铁背银猿群倾巢而出，老巢最是空虚的时候，铁背银猿群这么多年下来，肯定也积累了不少的好东西，这么多年来，死在他们手中的人类武者极多，一般的妖兽，对于人类掉落的东西没什么兴趣，但是猿类妖兽则不一样，它们的智慧要远远高过一般的妖兽，会搜集这些东西。
这些叶希文在一些杂记中看到过。
不一会儿，叶希文已经摸到了铁背银猿群的老巢，铁背银猿群的老巢是在一片峭壁之中的的，不过时间紧迫，恐怕也过不了多久，铁背银猿群就会回来了，叶希文不可能一个一个的搜刮过去，只能选择了一个最大的洞穴，那是铁背银猿王的洞穴，铁背银猿群中，等级非常的森严。
进了铁背银猿王的洞穴，首先扑面而来一阵酒香，让人迷醉。
猴儿酒！
叶希文脑海中冒出了这么一个名词，在一些游记上有记载，有些猴群会采集一些水果之类的发酵之后，酿成酒，就是所谓的猴儿酒。
叶希文目光扫了过去，只见洞内，有一个巨大的池子，池子里满是碧玉色的酒浆，酒香扑鼻，光是吸一口酒香，就有一种毛孔都张开的感觉，酒香之中蕴含着浓浓的灵气。
这绝对不是普通的猴儿酒，不是用一般的水果酿制的，恐怕这其中蕴含着很多的灵果以及什么天材地宝之类的。
叶希文没有犹豫，将这些猴儿酒，全部都装到了空间戒指中去了。
紧接着叶希文又扫了一眼整个洞穴，虽然洞穴很黑暗，但是在身怀武功的叶希文眼中，却是亮如白昼，在角落中，整整一堆的下品灵石都堆积在那里，散发出来的灵气让洞穴宛如一处洞天福地一般。
看了一下，起码有几千块下品灵石，叶希文一扫，全部都收进了空间戒指中了。
剩下的就是一些兵器和铠甲之类的，不少都已经残破了，许多都已经经过许多年之后，生锈腐烂了，都没什么价值了。
这些东西叶希文都不可能带走，只在其中选择了一把长刀，这把长刀被附上了厚厚的尘土，也不知道经历了多少年，但是却不曾腐烂，刀身泛着一股慑人的寒芒，通体都是精金制成的，锋利无比。
选择长刀的原因也很简单，就是因为之前得到了冷月斩这部刀法，现在有长刀正好。
叶希文将长刀绑到身上之后，立刻就转身离开，不敢在这里久待。
将整个猿王的洞府扫荡了一拳之后，叶希文一下子暴富了，原本还为了几十块下品灵石的事情额烦恼，现在一下子就得到了几千块，一下子就成款爷了。

叶希文的脸上还充满着狂喜的表情，这次真的是发大了！
叶希文从空间戒指中，装了一葫芦的猴儿酒，原来是用来装水的，现在全部都用来装猴儿酒了。
喝了一口，顿时觉得一股热流从小腹中蹿了起来，叶希文惊奇的发现，自己的力量居然增加了，虽然连半斤都不到，但是毫无疑问，猴儿酒果然是有奇效，里面也不知道蕴含了多少的天材地宝，难怪这些铁背银猿各个身强体壮，刀枪不入呢。
叶希文找了个离张家武者和铁背银猿**战的地方不算太远的地方，远远的可以看到双方的交战已经进入了白热化的阶段了，杀气冲天，其他的妖兽都不敢靠近这一带。
叶希文在树上挖了一个树洞开始闭关。
这一刻，大量的灵石都开始燃烧，大批大批的灵气都涌入叶希文的身体中，叶希文闭上眼睛，进入了那个神秘的空间，同时不断的喝着猴儿酒，力量不断暴涨起来。

content_en:
This iron-backed silver ape king is really fierce!
The two sides were already anxious, and they didn't care about why they fought before. The iron-backed silver ape was invincible, but the Zhang family's warriors also practiced various martial arts, and they were inseparable for a while.
The scar-faced middle-aged man has already faced off against the Iron-backed Silver Ape King, but the scar-faced middle-aged man who was so murderous just now was completely put at a disadvantage by the Iron-backed Silver Ape King. He is only the seventh level acquired, but this Iron-backed Silver Ape King is already the eighth level acquired, and is firmly suppressing him.
Ye Xiwen knew that the defeat of these warriors was only a matter of time. Ye Xiwen quietly left the battlefield, went around, and rushed to the lair of the iron-backed silver apes.
Now that the Iron-backed Silver Apes are out in force, and the nest is most empty, the Iron-backed Silver Apes must have accumulated a lot of good things over the years. Over the years, many human warriors have died in their hands. Ordinary monsters have little interest in things dropped by humans, but ape monsters are different. Their intelligence is much higher than ordinary monsters, and they will collect these things.
Ye Xiwen had seen these in some miscellaneous notes.
After a while, Ye Xiwen had already touched the nest of the Iron-backed Silver Apes. The nest of the Iron-backed Silver Apes was in a cliff. However, time was tight and it would not be long before the Iron-backed Silver Apes would come back. Ye Xiwen could not search them one by one, so he could only choose the largest cave, which was the cave of the Iron-backed Silver Ape King. Among the Iron-backed Silver Apes, the hierarchy was very strict.
Entering the cave of the Iron-backed Silver Ape King, the first thing that hits your face is the aroma of wine, which makes you intoxicated.
Monkey wine!
Such a term came to Ye Xiwen's mind. It was recorded in some travel notes that some monkey groups would collect some fruits and ferment them to make wine, which is the so-called monkey wine.
Ye Xiwen glanced over and saw a huge pool inside the cave. The pool was filled with jasper-colored wine pulp. The aroma of wine was astounding. Just taking a sip of the aroma of wine made you feel like your pores were opening. The aroma of wine contained a strong aura.
This is definitely not an ordinary monkey wine, and it is not brewed with ordinary fruits. I am afraid that it contains a lot of spiritual fruits and other natural and earthly treasures.
Ye Xiwen did not hesitate and put all the monkey wine into the space ring.
Then Ye Xiwen glanced at the entire cave. Although the cave was very dark, in the eyes of Ye Xiwen, who was skilled in martial arts, it was as bright as day. In the corner, a whole pile of low-grade spiritual stones were piled there. The aura emanating from it made the cave feel like a paradise.
After taking a look, there were at least several thousand low-grade spiritual stones. Ye Xiwen swept them all away and put them all into the space ring.
What's left are some weapons and armors, many of which are broken, and many of which have been rusted and rotten for many years and have no value anymore.
It was impossible for Ye Xiwen to take away these things, so he only chose a long knife among them. This long knife was covered with thick dust and had not decayed for an unknown number of years. The blade glowed with a frightening cold light. It was made of pure gold and was extremely sharp.
The reason for choosing the long sword is also very simple, it is because I got the sword skill of Leng Yue Zhan before, and now I have the long sword.
After Ye Xiwen tied the long knife to his body, he immediately turned around and left, not daring to stay here for long.
After sweeping away the entire Ape King's cave with one punch, Ye Xiwen suddenly became rich. He was originally worried about dozens of low-grade spiritual stones, but now he got thousands of them, and he suddenly became a rich man.
Ye Xiwen's face was still full of ecstasy, and this time it really got bigger!
Ye Xiwen filled a gourd of monkey wine from the space ring. It was originally used to hold water, but now it is all used to hold monkey wine.After taking a sip, he suddenly felt a wave of heat rising from his lower abdomen. Ye Xiwen was surprised to find that his strength had increased. Although it was not even half a catty, there was no doubt that the monkey wine had miraculous effects. It was unknown how many natural and earthly treasures it contained. No wonder these iron-backed silver apes were all strong and invulnerable.
Ye Xiwen found a place not too far away from the place where the Zhang family warriors and the iron-backed silver ape were fighting. From a distance, he could see that the battle between the two sides had entered a fierce stage, with murderous intent so high that other monsters did not dare to approach this area.
Ye Xiwen dug a tree hole in the tree and began to retreat.
At this moment, a large number of spiritual stones began to burn, and large amounts of spiritual energy poured into Ye Xiwen's body. Ye Xiwen closed his eyes and entered the mysterious space. At the same time, he continued to drink monkey wine, and his strength continued to increase.
